(main_task pid=3548832) Doc 3(Title: "Ralph Leighton") Ralph Leighton Ralph Leighton (; born 1949) is an American biographer, film producer, and friend of the late physicist Richard Feynman. He recorded Feynman relating stories of his life. Leighton has released some of the recordings as ""The Feynman Tapes"". These interviews became the basis for the books ""Surely You're Joking, Mr. Feynman!"" and ""What Do You Care What Other People Think?"", which were later combined into the hardcover anniversary edition ""Classic Feynman: All the Adventures of a Curious Character"". Leighton is an amateur drummer and founder of the group Friends of Tuva. In 1990 he cofounded the Tangled Web Theatre Company. Leighton is married with three sons, Jason, David, and Paul. He resides in Boston, Massachusetts.

From his hikes in the Alps with the Eagle Regiment and phone calls with his rock hound friend Sylvester to his sophisticated views of complicated topics such as: the explanation of a macroscopic universe in terms of quantum optics. The book contains recorded conversations of Feynman. On the tapes, other readers reveal aspects of Feynman's life. </information>
